title: Grave of the Fireflies
synopsis: Two siblings struggle to survive in Japan during World War II after their home is destroyed and their parents are lost.

title: Spirited Away
synopsis: A young girl named Chihiro becomes trapped in a mysterious spirit world and must find a way to free herself and her parents.

title: Your Name
synopsis: Two teenagers mysteriously swap bodies and form a profound connection while trying to meet each other in real life.

title: A Silent Voice
synopsis: A former bully seeks redemption by trying to reconnect with a deaf girl he tormented during his childhood.

title: Princess Mononoke
synopsis: A young warrior becomes entangled in a battle between the gods of the forest and humans who consume its resources.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
synopsis: Two young sisters move to the countryside and encounter friendly forest spirits, including the gentle Totoro.

title: The Garden of Words
synopsis: A high school student and a mysterious woman form a bond during rainy mornings in a quiet Tokyo garden.

title: Demon Slayer: Mugen Train
synopsis: Tanjiro and his allies board the Mugen Train to assist the Flame Hashira in battling a powerful demon haunting the passengers.

title: The Wind Rises
synopsis: A fictionalized biography of Jiro Horikoshi, the designer of Japanese fighter planes during World War II.

title: Suzume
synopsis: A teenage girl embarks on a journey across Japan to close mysterious doors that bring natural disasters.

title: Akira
synopsis: In a dystopian Neo-Tokyo, a teenager gains psychic powers that threaten to destroy the city and humanity itself.

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle
synopsis: Tanjiro and the Demon Slayer Corps enter Muzan Kibutsuji’s terrifying Infinity Castle for the final battle to end the demon threat once and for all.
